name: All Stackables to 200
description: Raise the stack size of every stackable item.

sql.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS yulon_stackable_backup (entry INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, stackable INT NOT NULL, maxcount INT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB;
sql.note: the undo, taken before anything is changed

sql.statement: INSERT IGNORE INTO yulon_stackable_backup (entry, stackable, maxcount) SELECT entry, stackable, maxcount FROM item_template WHERE (stackable > 1 OR maxcount > 1) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item_template WHERE stackable = 200) < 1000;
sql.note: INSERT IGNORE so a second install never overwrites the ORIGINAL values; skipped when the 200s are already in (an install from before the backup existed), so those are never recorded as the originals
upstream ships one size, 200, and its undo; the backup above is taken first so Remove can put every stack size back exactly

sql.statement: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS yulon_stackable_backup (entry INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, stackable INT NOT NULL, maxcount INT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB;
sql.note: so removing an install from before the backup existed still has a table to read (it holds nothing)

sql.statement: UPDATE item_template t JOIN yulon_stackable_backup b ON b.entry = t.entry SET t.stackable = b.stackable, t.maxcount = b.maxcount;

notes: The upstream Down script cannot restore the original stack sizes or per-character limits (it does not know them), so the table `yulon_stackable_backup` (stackable and maxcount, as INT: some currency items sit at 2147483647) is filled before Up and put back after Down on Remove. Do not drop it by hand.
